summary: New data centers are ineligible for the Enterprise Zone property tax exemption from June 5 2026 until 90 days after the 2027 session adjourns sine die. Projects already approved keep their benefits. The Strategic Investment Program is unaffected.
notes: Carve-out survived. Originated in the Nathanson -B24 amendment adopted March 2 2026 in Ways and Means Capital Construction. OBI testimony noted -24 carried no data center definition; ORS 308.505 has three. Check which definition the enrolled text uses.
confidence_note: Relayed from a law firm summary; enrolled bill text on OLIS not read.
